name: Window Prep (Substrate-Specific)
intent: Prep tasks gate by substrate type AND substrate state. Wood windows need sand+fill (bare) or sand (factory primed). Aluminum needs degrease+etch. Steel needs degrease+rust treatment. All substrates get a final clean pass before primer.
doctrine: TSK_WIN_SAND replaces the prior split between WOOD_SAND (bare wood) and SCUFF (factory primed); the universal sand task applies to both states at 12 EA/hr (mid-rate compromise). Bare wood still gets the additional fill pass. Metal prep is substrate-specific: aluminum needs etching for paint adhesion, steel needs rust treatment. The degrease step is shared between aluminum and steel (gated by substrate=[aluminum, steel]). All paths converge on the final clean step before primer.
